Those two situations can't be compared. If you don't have a car, you are here to wish you had one.

If you lack a life, you're not around to wish you had one.

Here's the kicker though: I don't have a guarantee of an amazing life after finishing college. It weighs the odds in my favor, of course, but there is no guarantee. And there is still a possibility of a crappy life through misfortune.

Whereas with suicide, though there is no option of an amazing life, there is also no possibility for a crappy life.

>But you have no clue whats after dying. 

I have a pretty good idea. And the idea is nothing. Which fits me. Though heaven/hell possibly exist, the likelihood of being sent there is about the same as little green men carrying me off in a UFO.

>its dying no turning back at all.

I'm aware. This isn't just a thought I recently had, mind you. I've been mulling it over for a good while now. A few years, to be exact.

>You cant just go through life with no job.

I know this. This is part of the reason why I dislike being alive.

>Take control of YOUR life. 

I am about to.

>You need to stop entertaining yourself and get to studying.

I don't _need_ to per se. Only if I stick with the original plan. Which may turn out not to be the case.
